verdict.head: UNUSABLE as a head: a bare sphere with a 10 % rim and cel gloss; after normalising it is a plain circle (no expression, no neck, no ears, no hair slot) - Open Peeps heads are strictly better
verdict.hair: UNUSABLE: tufts/mushroom shapes for monsters; no coherent hair for people
verdict.eyes: PARTLY USABLE as eye-state references only: eyes5 (plain dots) / eyes6 (glossy) - our editorial eye already covers this; no gain
verdict.mouths: REFERENCE: 8 simple mouth curves (mouth1-4 are ink strokes that fit our style); weaker than the Open Peeps face atoms
verdict.hands: UNUSABLE: a solid black blob without fingers
verdict.body: UNUSABLE: a pill-shaped torso without arms; feet solid black
verdict.animation: 42 frames per part (idle/walk/roll/hit/death...) on registered 2048 px canvases: a clean sprite-sheet pipeline, but frame-by-frame raster: incompatible with our IK rig
